item.description:
# Discs 4.7.6
- Give every view its own artwork size. Use ⌘ + and ⌘ − to resize the active view without changing the others; press ⌘ 0 to restore its default size. - Find a more welcoming guide to Discs features in About, with clearer descriptions across the release history.

# Discs 4.7.5
- Reorder and resize the existing columns in Locations list view. - Show the full album tables in artist profiles without nested scrolling. - Simplify the empty state in Favorites and center the active album and artist in Now Playing.

# Discs 4.7
- Browse Artists in table or grid view, open profiles from either view, and view an artist’s albums in a table. - Personalize artist profiles with original-quality banners and photos, optional dynamic backgrounds, and smoother navigation. - Explore release and acquisition dates in Calendar with clearer date labels, anniversary markers, and album tables. - Enjoy a refined Now Playing layout and a flat, spaced artwork carousel. - Control dynamic backgrounds separately for Now Playing and artist profiles, and use Settings windows that adapt to their content. - See more natural in-app anniversary notifications that mention album names. - Use a simplified toolbar and browse a refreshed, scrollable About page.

# Discs 4.6
- Add CDs to your collection in five focused steps for album details, artwork, tracklists, collection details, and notes, with a window that adapts to each step. - Add albums to your wishlist in a dedicated form with artwork, artist, and album fields, available from the Add menu or Command–Shift–N. - Complete wishlist album and artist names from selected artwork search results, matching artists already in your library. - Browse compact artwork search results in a four-column grid, with improved handling of punctuation and apostrophes in album and artist names. - Search tracklists in a floating results panel below the search bar, import multi-disc releases into separate editors, and add or remove tracklists with compact controls. - Reuse cached artwork and load covers for online lyrics results concurrently, displaying artwork from your collection immediately when available. - Open the newly added album after saving to your collection, or return to Wishlist after adding a wishlist album. - Retry artwork searches when MusicBrainz temporarily limits requests, with clearer service availability messages.

# Discs 4.5.1
- Simplify Now Playing to two columns, with album information beside the selected song’s lyrics. - Choose songs from a bold title menu, with the first track selected when opening an album and previous/next arrows beside the title. - Improve song title contrast against light and dark album backgrounds, with more space around the menu indicator. - Set lyrics to 12 points in Now Playing and album details for a more compact reading layout. - Keep the Add Lyrics action available for songs without saved lyrics and preserve instrumental track messages. - Fix the Check for Updates menu so its enabled state follows Sparkle after automatic update checks.

# Discs 4.5
- Edit albums in dedicated Details, Artwork, Tracklist, Lyrics, and Notes sections, with tracklist editing sized to the content and separate blocks for multi-disc releases. - Keep lyrics paired with their tracks; replacing a tracklist now warns before deleting its saved lyrics. - Move through songs with the keyboard in Now Playing and album details, and read lyrics in a side panel without covering album information. - Improve toolbar customization, keep controls in a consistent order, and choose icon-only or icon-and-text labels. - Truncate album details cleanly in narrow layouts and prevent them from flashing while switching songs. - Make genre and profile views more responsive, support five-character minimum passwords for library backups, and fix Swift 6 decoding isolation in artwork search.

# Discs 4.4
- Enter album details manually, then find artwork with MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive. - Search for an album’s tracklist and import its tracks into editable single-disc or multi-disc sections. - Search lyrics by song in Edit CD, with a more responsive collection search. - Build and use a shuffle queue more clearly, edit the active CD from Now Playing, and see improved dark-mode contrast. - Find related search suggestions in Listen History and Now Playing.

# Discs 4.3
- Add albums with a redesigned search or manual workflow, including a wishlist option. - Move wishlist albums to your collection with a confirmation and available release date and tracklist. - Customize your library with refreshed Settings and flat or 3D artwork. - Browse album notes beside more music from the same artist. - Enjoy improvements to lyrics navigation, artist profiles, locations, and the first-run tutorial.

# Discs 4.2.9
- Refine artist profiles with full-width banners, white artist names, and Liquid Glass Total and Plays pills. - Zoom and reposition artist banners and profile photos while editing.

# Discs 4.2.8
- Give artist profiles a bold new look with edge-to-edge banners, a theme-matched gradient, and a refreshed profile photo editor. - Limit artist banners and profile photos to 15 MB and 24 megapixels, and save them at up to 2048 pixels. - Enjoy a clearer Now Playing experience with a fixed-size cover, adaptive location selector, and messages for empty locations. - Keep wishlist artwork fully opaque while dimming it. - Set the Settings window to a fixed height of 700 points.

item.title: Discs 4.2.0
item.description:
What’s New in Discs 4.2.0

  • Build a shuffle queue in Now Playing and browse its selected albums in the carousel.
  • Search lyrics by song, artist, and album, including combined searches.
  • Identify instrumental search results and mark selected tracks as instrumental.
  • Show only the interactive tutorial on first launch until it is completed or skipped.
  • Includes collection editing, layout, artwork scaling, and navigation improvements.

item.title: Discs 4.1.1
item.description:
What’s New in Discs 4.1.1

Fixes the Sparkle update package signing so the app validates and installs correctly.

item.title: Discs 4.1
item.description:
What’s New in Discs 4.1

  • A simpler Add CD flow for entering the CDs you own.
  • Find an editable tracklist through iTunes.
  • Search iTunes for artwork, with clear image limits before importing.
  • LRCLIB remains available for lyrics.
  • Removed MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, automatic metadata and the separate music-database search.
  • Simplified legacy backup import while retaining encrypted backups and import safety checks.

item.title: Discs 4.0
item.description: Password-protected library backups, independent grid and list preferences, and collection and navigation improvements. Requires an Apple silicon Mac.

item.title: Discs 3.9
item.description: Security and privacy improvements for library backups, images, and online searches. Requires an Apple silicon Mac.

What's new in Discs 3.7.0

  • Search for standard-size album artwork when adding or editing a CD.
  • Choose an image from your Mac or search online by artist and album.
  • Choose the iTunes Store country and preview artwork before applying it.

Discs 3.6.1

Updates What’s New with the 3.6 features and a simplified history of major releases.

What's new in Discs 3.6.0

  • Search CD editions by artist, title, or barcode and review imported artwork, genre, release date, and tracklist.
  • Search lyrics in your collection or online, with more precise matches and album artwork.
  • Add missing lyrics directly from CD details or Now Playing.
  • Open CD search with Command-Shift-N.

What's new in Discs 3.5.0

  • Create a local profile with a custom name and photo.
  • See collection totals, recent albums, and all-time listening favorites.
  • Include your profile in library backups and follow your preferred shelf style and zoom.
  • Filter listening history by month, year, or all time.

What’s new in Discs 3.4.0

  • Edit shared CD fields with clear mixed values and pickers for tags, locations, editions, and imported countries.
  • See consistent domestic, imported, unknown-country, and unset labels across album details and tables.
  • Find clearer context-menu actions with system icons, and edit multiple selected albums from the grid or table.
  • Use simplified Settings, more focused artist, genre, and location tables, and a compact recent listening-history preview.
  • Search the manual CD picker in Shuffle and use a simpler Now Playing experience.
  • Removed phrase-based notifications.

What’s new in Discs 3.3.0

  • Select multiple CDs in All CDs and edit shared details such as tags, locations, edition, and country of origin together.
  • Open the complete listening history in its own view.
  • Search listening history by artist, album, or genre with matching results across the page.
  • Improved navigation stability when opening artist profiles.

What’s new

  • Choose a home country and set a country of origin for each CD. Existing albums stay unchanged unless you edit their country.
  • Sort each location table independently.
  • See the selected album under the Now Playing title and use an improved location selector.
  • Search genres globally and avoid duplicate albums in tag results.
  • Lyrics adapt their contrast to the album background.
  • Library Dates uses native Liquid Glass options.
